note: No organiser validation_rules.json was issued. These are the deterministic checks implemented in src/data/validate.py, exported declaratively. The rule engine executes the Python predicates in this module; this file is the declarative description of them, not the executable source.
severity_scale: 0-20, subtracted from a 100-point record score, higher is worse

rules.name: origination_after_reporting
rules.description: Origination month is later than the reporting month.

rules.name: last_updated_before_period_end
rules.description: Servicing record was last written before the reporting period closed.

rules.name: loan_age_inconsistent_with_dates
rules.description: Reported loan age disagrees with reporting minus origination month by >2 months.

rules.name: balance_exceeds_original
rules.description: Current balance exceeds original balance by more than 2%.

rules.name: balance_increase_month_over_month
rules.description: Unpaid principal balance rose month over month on a non-modified loan.

rules.name: dpd_sentinel_value
rules.description: Days past due carries a sentinel value (9999, -1).

rules.name: status_dpd_mismatch
rules.description: Days past due is inconsistent with the reported performance status.

rules.name: interest_rate_out_of_range
rules.description: Note rate outside a plausible 0.5%-25% range.

rules.name: remaining_term_inconsistent
rules.description: Remaining term plus loan age is not a standard contractual term.

rules.name: missing_critical_field
rules.description: A field required for credit assessment is missing.

rules.name: document_file_incomplete
rules.description: Document custody status is missing or in exception.

rules.name: stale_servicer_reporting
rules.description: Record last updated more than 75 days after the period closed.

rules.name: servicer_balance_break
rules.description: Servicer feed balance differs from the panel by >1% and >$500.

rules.name: servicer_status_conflict
rules.description: Servicer feed reports a different performance status than the panel.

rules.name: servicer_record_absent
rules.description: No servicer feed record exists for this loan month.

rules.name: terminal_status_with_balance
rules.description: Loan is in a terminal status but still carries a material balance.
